name: Arrowhead
author: byo-pop
description: A game mode for a challenge: arrow gems climb one gem up the board after every move, and if one leaves the top, the game is over. The only move is a twist: click where four gems meet to turn them clockwise, or right click to turn them the other way, and a twist that holds an arrow carries it a cell around, even back down. When gems below an arrow clear, it falls with the rest; match the arrow itself for a bonus that grows with each one cleared. Eight kinds of gem. A new arrow starts at the bottom every few moves, more often as the levels go up. Uses its own high-score table.
